heading: Our coverage continues
body: This live page is now closed, but our round-the-clock coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran, the fighting in Yemen, as well as Israel’s attacks on Gaza, the occupied West Bank and Lebanon continues.

heading: Here’s what happened today
body: This live page will close soon. Before we go, here’s a look at some of the top recent developments:

heading: WATCH: Has Gaza broken the Israel consensus in the US?
body: For decades, US support for Israel was one of Washington’s few unbreakable bipartisan positions. The genocide in Gaza has changed that.

heading: 6 killed as IRGC raid targets ‘terrorists’ planning attack near Tehran
body: Iranian forces have killed six members of a “terrorist group” allegedly planning an operation in Manjilabad near Tehran.

heading: Gaza’s healthcare crisis leaves breast cancer patients without early detection
body: The Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza has warned that breast cancer patients in Gaza face a “catastrophic health and humanitarian reality” that denies them basic medical care and their right to treatment.

heading: Oil falls following US-Iran counterproposal
body: Oil prices have dropped about 1 percent amid a cautious diplomatic back-and-forth between Tehran and Washington, Reuters reports.

heading: Israeli military conducts large explosion in second southern Lebanon town
body: Lebanon’s state-run NNA has reported that a large explosion has been carried out by the Israeli army in the southern town of Hula.

heading: Saudi Arabia approves $59m of budget funding for Yemen’s government
body: Saudi Arabia has approved 224 million Saudi riyals ($59.7m) in budget funding for Yemen’s internationally recognised government amid intense battles with the Houthis.

heading: Government says nearly 198,000 Yemenis forcibly displaced amid worsening humanitarian crisis
body: The number of people in Yemen internally displaced amid the latest escalations has risen to 198,000 people, the government has said.

heading: Supertanker hit in Strait of Hormuz, Iranian media reports
body: A supertanker has been hit in the Strait of Hormuz and is now burning, according to Iran’s Fars news agency which cited local sources.

heading: US waives human rights conditions for $320m military aid to Egypt amid Iran war: Report
body: The US State Department waived human rights conditions for more than $300m of military aid to Egypt in light of Cairo’s “helpful role” since the launch of the US war with Iran, according to a letter to US lawmakers obtained by the Reuters news agency.

heading: Iranian UN mission says China, Russia ‘rightly’ vetoed resolution monitoring Iran sanctions
body: The Iranian mission to the United Nations has said China and Russia “rightly” vetoed the US-led draft Security Council resolution to extend monitoring of sanctions against Iran.

heading: WATCH: What’s driving Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank?
body: Israeli settlements in the occupied Palestinian territory are illegal under international law, but Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s government has approved plans to expand them in the occupied West Bank.

heading: US faces ‘humiliating situation’ across the region, Iran’s Quds Force commander says
body: Esmail Qaani, commander of the Quds Force in the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), says Iran is witnessing a new era of resistance against US hegemony, Iran’s Fars news agency reports.

heading: Here’s more on the US Energy Dept employee arrested for allegedly helping Yemen’s Houthis
body: The US Justice Department statement has said Energy Department Employee Ashton Hamed Ellaboudy, “came to the attention of the FBI after they received information that he had purchased precursor chemicals, components, and other materials commonly used in the construction of homemade explosive devices

heading: Israeli attacks continue across southern Lebanon
body: Israeli forces have fired at least two artillery shells near a refinery station located in Marjayoun in southern Lebanon, according to the country’s National News Agency.

heading: Iran border attack kills security personnel
body: At least one Iranian security personnel has been killed in an attack on a checkpoint near the city of Rask on the border with Pakistan, according to Iran’s state-run broadcaster IRIB.

heading: Muslim World League condemns Houthi strike on Medina power station serving Masjid an-Nabawi
body: The Muslim World League has condemned a Houthi attack on the Taibah electricity distribution station in Medina, Saudi Arabia, saying the facility provides electricity services to Prophet Muhammad’s mosque (Masjid an-Nabawi).

heading: Clashes between Yemeni government forces, Houthis reported north of Taiz
body: The Taiz Military Axis media centre, part of the Yemeni goverment forces’ communication wing, is reporting “violent clashes” between Houthi and goverment forces north of the city of Taiz.

heading: Yemen government forces say they targeted Houthis in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz
body: Yemen’s military says it targeted Houthi positions in the capital Sanaa, the northwestern province of Saada, and the southwestern province of Taiz.

heading: Over 2,000 Israeli settler, military attacks during September in the occupied West Bank: Palestinian commission
body: Israeli forces and settlers carried out 2,051 attacks against Palestinians, their land and property in September 2026, according to the Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission, Wafa has reported.

heading: Bahrain strongly condemns attack on Medina power distribution centre
body: Bahrain has strongly condemned an alleged attack by Yemen’s Houthis on an electricity distribution station in Medina.

heading: What’s been happening in the occupied West Bank?
body: Israeli military forces and settlers are continuing their attacks on towns and villages in the occupied West Bank.

heading: France says G7 to offer up to 100 million barrels of diesel and oil to each other over next 4 months
body: France has agreed to continue to coordinate actions to help energy supplies come out of the Strait of Hormuz, according to French President Emmanuel Macron, adding that G7 states intend to offer up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil to each other over the next four months.

heading: Two children, one woman among six wounded in Yemen’s Taiz
body: Six civilians, including two children and a woman, have been wounded in artillery shelling of residential neighbourhoods in central Taiz, according to Yemen’s state-run Saba news agency.

heading: Best outcome of diesel release is to avoid price rises: Analyst
body: Neil Atkinson, former head of the International Energy Agency’s oil division, told Al Jazeera the G7’s release of 100 million in emergency reserves addresses the symptoms of the diesel squeeze, not its cause.

heading: Israeli military conducts explosion in southern Lebanon
body: Lebanon’s state-run National News Agency has reported two large explosions were carried out by the Israeli army in the southern Lebanon town of Majdal Zoun.

heading: US senators slam war in Iran, denouncing Trump for sending troops, price increases
body: Democratic Party senators have denounced the US war on Iran, laying the blame at US President Donald Trump’s feet.

heading: UK condemns Houthi attacks in Yemen’s Taiz
body: The United Kingdom has condemned what it called the latest Houthi attacks in Yemen’s Taiz and the threat they pose to civilians.

heading: Israeli air strike targets residential building in Gaza, kills one
body: An Israeli air strike has targeted a residential apartment complex west of Gaza City.

heading: Yemeni army says it carried out 71 attacks on Houthi targets in Taiz
body: Yemen’s armed forces say they carried out 71 attacks, which they described as precision strikes, targeting Houthi gatherings, reinforcements and military buildups across several areas of Taiz province.

heading: WATCH: Israeli general says Gaza captives could have been freed a year earlier
body: Israeli reserve Major-General Nitzan Alon told a Washington Institute forum that all captives in Gaza could have been freed a year earlier without changing the war’s outcome, potentially saving thousands of lives.

heading: Trump says Iran war could end ‘very soon, probably right after the elections’
body: US President Donald Trump, speaking at a rally in Mobile, Alabama, has again said the war with Iran could end soon, while questioning whom in Tehran Washington could negotiate with and insisting Iran must never obtain a nuclear weapon.

heading: What Gaza voters want as first Palestinian elections in two decades approach?
body: Ahead of the first Palestinian national elections in 20 years, people in Gaza are hoping to rebuild after Israeli destruction.

heading: Several Palestinians injured in settler attack south of Nablus
body: A number of Palestinians have suffered injuries in an attack by Israeli settlers, targeting olive harvesters in the town of Awarta, south of Nablus, in the northern occupied West Bank, our colleagues on the ground are reporting.

heading: Photos: Aftermath of overnight Israeli strike on apartment building that kills 5 in Gaza
body: A Palestinian inspects the site of an Israeli strike on an apartment building in Gaza City on October 3, 2026 [Dawoud Abu Alkas/Reuters]

heading: Jerusalem’s Latin patriarch mourns ‘tragic’ killing of Christian women in Israeli attack on Gaza
body: Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa, the Latin patriarch of Jerusalem, has issued a statement expressing his “deep sorrow and grief” over the “tragic” killing of two Christian women in an Israeli air attack on Gaza City on Friday evening.

heading: IEA says 325 million barrels of oil from strategic reserves released so far
body: The International Energy Agency (IEA) says member countries have so far released 325 million barrels of oil and oil-derivative products from their strategic reserves out of the 400 million barrels promised in March.

heading: Yemeni government forces confirm attacks on ‘military targets’ in Houthi-held Sanaa
body: The internationally recognised government’s forces have announced attacks “on legitimate vital military targets” in the Houthi-held capital Sanaa.

heading: Attacks on tankers in Strait of Hormuz spike over recent days
body: At least three tankers were struck by unidentified projectiles in and around the Strait of Hormuz over the last 24 hours, according to United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) warnings, marking a sharp escalation in commercial shipping attacks.

heading: Iran determined to show it is in full control of Strait of Hormuz
body: Reporting from Tehran, Iran

heading: Palestinians fear continued escalations as genocide in Gaza marks third year
body: Reporting from Gaza, Palestine

heading: Iraqi oil tanker company says 2 million barrels of crude transported through Strait of Hormuz
body: ⁠Iraq’s ⁠Oil Tankers Company has transported 2 ⁠million barrels of ⁠Iraqi crude aboard a very ‌large crude carrier (VLCC) through the Strait of Hormuz, its director general ⁠said in ⁠a statement.

heading: Olive harvesting season comes with more settler attacks in the West Bank
body: Reporting from Hebron, occupied West Bank

heading: WATCH: Netanyahu’s fight to own the election narrative
body: With elections one month away, the media discourse in Israel has narrowed in on one question about one man: What did Benjamin Netanyahu know before October 7?

heading: Israel’s strikes in Gaza send message that ‘no one has immunity’
body: Ahmed al-Tanani, a Palestinian researcher and political writer, has told Al Jazeera that civilian deaths in Israeli strikes on Gaza are not “collateral damage” but part of a deliberate message to Palestinians.

heading: Iran welcomes exit of US forces from Iraq, calls for Washington to be held accountable
body: Iran’s Foreign Ministry has congratulated the Iraqi government and people on the exit of US and other foreign forces from Iraq, in a statement posted on its Telegram channel.

heading: Medvedev says Russia is ready to mediate between US and Iran
body: Dmitry Medvedev, the deputy chairman of Russia’s Security Council, has been speaking to Iranian media about the US and Israel’s war on Iran.

heading: WATCH: Israeli air attack on residential apartment in Gaza kills 5 Palestinians
body: An Israeli air attack on a residential apartment in Gaza City has killed at least five Palestinians and severely wounded six others, according to medical staff.

heading: Palestinian children released from Israeli detention emerge ‘destroyed’
body: Ayed Abu Eqtaish, the director of the SEYAJ Organization for Child Protection, says psychological “resources are very limited” for Palestinian children arrested by the Israeli military.

heading: Iran ‘serious’ about diplomacy, ‘serious’ about defending itself: Araghchi
body: Iran’s foreign minister Abbas Araghchi has said Tehran is “serious about finding diplomatic solutions, just as we are serious about defending ourselves”.

heading: What do we know about efforts to end the US-Israel war on Iran?
One killed, 10 wounded in Israeli attack on Gaza
body: A medical source in Gaza says one person has been killed and 10 wounded in an Israeli air strike on a vehicle south of Deir el-Balah in central Gaza.

heading: Battles ongoing for control over Yemen’s Kahboub Mountains
body: Heavy ground fighting is underway in Yemen’s Kahboub Mountains overlooking Bab al-Mandeb Strait.

heading: Iranian prisoners released from UAE jails after years of detention
body: A group of Iranian prisoners who spent years in prison in the United Arab Emirates have just been freed.

heading: WATCH: Israel deploys facial recognition to track Palestinians; guide military moves
body: Israel is deploying advanced facial recognition technology and other tools to track, monitor, and catalogue Palestinian people – entirely without their consent and to support military action.

heading: First flight from Iran lands in Iraq’s Najaf after nine days
body: The first flight from Iran has landed at Najaf International Airport in Iraq, carrying more than 150 passengers from Tehran, after flights between the two countries resumed following a halt of more than nine days, the Iraqi News Agency (INA) reported.

heading: Israeli air strike hits Haddatha in southern Lebanon
body: Israeli jets have struck the town of Haddatha in Lebanon’s Bint Jbeil district, Lebanon’s state-run National News Agency is reporting.

heading: WATCH: There is ‘no military solution’ to end the war, Iran tells US
Israeli forces carry out demolitions in Gaza City
body: Israeli forces are carrying out demolition operations east of the Tuffah neighbourhood in eastern Gaza City, according to our correspondent on the ground.

heading: Defence expert says Yemen’s decisive battle marks departure from Stockholm agreement
body: Defence analyst Ibrahim Jalal, who specialises in regional security and armed groups, says the Yemeni response has just begun.

heading: Israeli army claims it killed two Hamas members in Gaza
body: The Israeli army says it has killed two people in Gaza it claims were members of Hamas.

heading: Photos: Far-right Jake Lang protests Palestine Festival in Illinois
body: Far-right activist Jake Lang, centre, protests against the annual Palestine Fest outside SeatGeek Stadium in Bridgeview, Illinois [Kamil Krzaczynski/AFP]

heading: Israeli army kills man in southern Syria
body: The Israeli army says its forces have “neutralized” a suspect who allegedly attempted to infiltrate one of its sites in southern Syria.

heading: Kuwait condemns Israeli violations in Syria
body: Kuwait’s Foreign Ministry has expressed the country’ “strong condemnation and denunciation of the ongoing violations perpetrated by the Israeli occupation in the territories of the fraternal Arab Republic of Syria”.

heading: Photos: Iranian women volunteers receive military training in Tehran
body: Iranian women volunteers receive military training at a military training center for ordinary citizens at Imam Hussein Square in central Tehran, Iran, October 4, 2026 [Majid Asgaripour/West Asia News Agency/Reuters]

heading: US bombers at UK’s Fairford base were ‘out in the open’ and ‘vulnerable to drone attacks’
body: David des Roches, a professor at the Thayer Marshall Institute, says the Pentagon’s decision to remove its B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in the UK “should have [been] done a while ago”.

heading: Yemen’s government calls for international help to defeat Houthis
body: The foreign minister of Yemen’s internationally recognized government is asking the international community for more support to defeat the Houthis and says it’s “in the world’s interest” for the country to be stable.

heading: Yemen’s government forces claim regaining control of Bab al-Mandeb strait
body: The army of Yemen’s internationally recognised government says it has “succeeded in controlling” the Bab al-Mandeb strait and recaptured a nearby airport in the coastal town of Dhubab in the governorate of Taiz.

heading: US-sanctioned Iranian petrochemical producer reports $10bn in oil export revenues
body: A US-sanctioned Iranian petrochemical producer has generated $10bn in oil export revenues over the past two years, “having successfully navigated the constraints of the sanctions era and wartime conditions”, according to the Fars News Agency.

heading: Yemeni gov’t forces claim gains from Houthis near Bab al-Mandeb
body: The army of Yemen’s internationally recognized government says it seized Dhubab district near Bab al-Mandeb Strait after launching a “decisive military operation” against the Houthis.

heading: Situation in southern Syria worsening due to Israeli expansion
body: Reporting from Quneitra, southern Syria

heading: Saudi Arabia says Mecca alliance agrees to ‘activate collective deterrence measures’ to respond to attacks
body: Saudi Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman has issued a statement following an emergency meeting in Riyadh of the signatories of the Mecca pact, a joint defence agreement signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan.

heading: US embassy issues security alert for Americans in Saudi Arabia
body: The US embassy in Riyadh has issued a security alert for US citizens in Saudi Arabia.

heading: WATCH: Turkiye, Pakistan agree to military deployment to Saudi Arabia
Trump ‘deranged and dangerous’ for daring Iran to take out LA, California governor says
body: California Governor Gavin Newsom has denounced Trump’s comments that Iran can “take out Los Angeles or San Diego”.

heading: Israeli forces advance into former military site in southwestern Syria
body: Israeli military forces are advancing into a former military site in the Quneitra countryside within the occupied Golan Heights in southwestern Syria, according to our correspondent on the ground.

heading: Israeli forces storm Bethlehem localities, demolish home in East Jerusalem
body: Israeli forces have stormed multiple areas in the Bethlehem governorate of the occupied West Bank, the Wafa news agency reports.

heading: UK police arrest man for alleged ‘preparation of terrorist acts’ connected to RAF Fairford
body: The UK’s Counter Terrorism Police says they have carried out another arrest in connection with “activity that took place close to RAF Fairford,” the airbase used by the US to strike Iran.

heading: Opposing claims over Bab al-Mandeb and Dhubab fronts in Yemen
body: Reporting from Sanaa, Yemen

heading: UN chief calls on all parties in Iran war to ‘end conflict, return to diplomacy’
body: Speaking to reporters in Islamabad about the US-Israel war on Iran, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres says he wants to send a loud message to all parties: “End the conflict, return to diplomacy and restore navigational rights in accordance with international law.”

heading: Kuwaiti cabinet condemns Houthi attacks on Mecca and Medina
body: The Kuwaiti cabinet has strongly condemned Houthi attacks against Mecca and Medina in Saudi Arabia, according to the Kuwait News Agency (KUNA).

heading: Oman confirms medical evacuation of crew members from attacked oil tanker in Hormuz
body: Oman ⁠has confirmed a medical evacuation of 10 crew ⁠members from the Panama-flagged oil tanker ⁠On Peace, which was attacked near the Gulf country, the media office ‌of the sultanate’s armed forces says.

heading: Houthis killed six civilians in Yemen’s Taiz, Interior Ministry says
body: Six civilians have been killed in attacks launched by the Houthis in Yemen’s al-Mawasit and al-Misrakh districts in the southern Taiz governorate, according to the Interior Ministry.

heading: Rights groups urge Houthis to free detained UN and aid staff
body: Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch (HRW) and the Cairo Institute for Human Rights Studies have called on Yemen’s Houthis to “immediately and unconditionally release dozens of UN and civil society staff detained over the past two years”.

heading: Iran has ‘no problem providing foreign currency’, Central Bank chief says
body: Iran’s Central Bank governor says Tehran supplied $2bn in foreign currency to the market to show US President Donald Trump and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent that the country has no shortage of foreign exchange.

heading: Yemeni government-backed forces say they repelled Houthi attack in Dhubab district
body: Yemen’s government-backed Southern Giants Brigades say that they repelled a Houthi attack on their positions in the Dhubab district in the governorate of Taiz on the country’s western coast.

heading: Two ballistic missiles strike area near Aden International Airport
body: Reporting from Taiz, Yemen

heading: US lawmakers demand release of Palestinian healthcare workers detained by Israel
body: US Congressman Chuy Garcia and five other Democratic lawmakers have called for the immediate release of detained Palestinian healthcare workers, including Dr Hussam Abu Safia.

heading: Oil prices climb above $101 a barrel
body: Oil prices are continuing their upward trajectory, with Brent crude futures gaining 93 cents, or 0.92 percent, to reach $101.51 a barrel as of 00:22 GMT.

heading: Yemen’s Ministry of Human Rights condemns Houthi attack on Aden airport
body: The Ministry of Human Rights under Yemen’s internationally recognised government has condemned the missile attack by Houthi rebels on Aden International Airport.

heading: Civilians pay the price as fighting rages in war-ravaged Yemen
body: Reporting from Aden, Yemen

heading: Yemen’s displaced children dream of going back to school
body: At sunrise, 12-year-old Ahmed wakes up under the roof of a tent in a displacement camp in the Wadi Bani Khawlan area of Taiz governorate’s Jabal Habashi district.

heading: Saudi navy chief receives US naval commander to discuss maritime security
body: The chief of the Royal Saudi Naval Staff has received the commander of US Naval Forces Central Command and his team for talks in Saudi Arabia.

heading: Houthis say Yemeni government forces stopped from advancing in al-Jawf governorate
body: The Houthis’ military spokesperson, Yahya Saree, has said the group has prevented Yemeni government forces from gaining ground in the al-Jawf governorate.

heading: Oil flow through Hormuz over last two days down 60 percent: Iranian media
body: Iranian media is reporting a 60 percent decrease in oil passing through the Strait of Hormuz, saying that the flow of crude oil has faced a significant drop in the last two days, reaching around 3.8 million barrels per day.

heading: France to release 10 million barrels of diesel amid rising fuel prices
body: French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu has announced plans to release 10 million barrels of diesel from France’s strategic stocks to try to ease surging fuel prices, in part due to the US-Israel war on Iran.

heading: ‘Not opening new fronts’: Syria rules out possibility of getting involved in Yemen war
body: Syria’s Ministry of Information has denied rumours on X that suggest the possibility of getting involved in the Yemen conflict, saying, “Syria’s policy in the region is focused on stability, peace and cooperation, not opening new fronts.”

heading: Houthis claim Yemeni government forces struck with 11 missiles over past 24 hours
body: Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree has said the group targeted 11 groups of Yemeni government forces with ballistic missiles across Yemen in the past 24 hours.

heading: Here’s what happened on Wednesday
body: We will be closing this live page shortly. Before we do, here’s a recap of the day’s major developments:

heading: Oil prices slide to just over $100 a barrel
body: Oil prices have started on a downward trajectory, with Brent crude futures losing 38 cents, or 0.38 percent, to settle at $100.20 as of 20:31 GMT – shortly after New York markets closed – after reaching $101.51 earlier today.

heading: Muslim World League condemns Houthi ‘treacherous terrorist acts’ on Saudi airports
body: The Muslim World League (MWL) has condemned the Houthi attacks on Abha and King Khalid airports in Saudi Arabia.

heading: Israeli shelling kills Palestinian woman near Gaza City
body: Israeli artillery shelling has killed a Palestinian woman in Gaza City and wounded many others, the Wafa news agency reports.

heading: Israeli army kills a person for crossing ‘Yellow Line’ in Gaza
body: The Israeli army says it has killed one person who crossed the “Yellow Line”, which demarcates the area of Gaza that it controls.

heading: How much are sailors earning for daring to transit Strait of Hormuz?
body: As shipping traffic through the besieged Strait of Hormuz fell to its lowest level since July this week, reports have emerged that sailors are being paid large bonuses for making the dangerous trip through the Gulf waterway.

heading: Saudi-led coalition says three Houthi ballistic missiles intercepted
body: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said “it intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched by the terrorist Houthi militia towards Riyadh”.

heading: UK’s Jerusalem mission to ‘remain independent’
body: We have been speaking with Vincent Fean, the British consul general in Jerusalem from 2010 to 2014, about the renaming of the UK’s consulate in occupied ⁠East Jerusalem after Israel ordered it to close as part of a diplomatic dispute.

heading: US using every tool to sever Iran’s economic lifelines, State Department says
body: The United States is “using every diplomatic and economic tool” to sever Iran’s economic lifelines, according to a statement made by Department of State spokesman Tommy Pigott.

heading: Oman denounces Houthi attacks on Saudi airports
body: Oman has condemned the Houthis’ attacks on the Abha and King Khalid International Airports in Saudi Arabia.

heading: Palestinian killed by Israeli forces near Gaza’s Deir el-Balah
body: A Palestinian was killed by Israeli forces east of Deir el-Balah in the central Gaza Strip, a source from Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital tells Al Jazeera.

heading: WATCH: What is the Mecca defence pact?
body: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan are activating their defence pact to counter attacks from Yemen’s Houthis. What is this Mecca defence pact and could this new alliance reshape the Middle East’s balance of power?

heading: US Democrat senator says he was ‘barred’ from visiting American troops in the Middle East
body: Democratic Senator Chris Murphy has said he was prohibited from visiting American troops in the Middle East.

heading: OpenAI says Iran-linked network used ‘fake journalist’ personas to place US-Iran war articles
body: OpenAI says it disrupted an Iran-origin influence operation that used fake journalist identities to place articles about the US-Iran conflict in online publications around the world.

heading: US Senator Chris Murphy accuses Pentagon of ‘cover-up’ over Iran war costs and damage
body: US Democratic Senator Chris Murphy has accused the Department of Defense of trying to hide the costs and failures of the war on Iran after he was denied access to US military facilities in the region.

heading: Iran weighs US proposal as Tehran signals nuclear defiance and war readiness
body: Iran has continued to balance diplomacy with Washington against displays of military resolve, from the Strait of Hormuz to its ability to sustain a prolonged war. Here are the main developments:

heading: Iran pursuing national and international avenues for justice over Minab school attack
body: Iran’s deputy minister for human rights, Askar Jalalian, has announced that efforts are being made to seek justice for the victims of February’s Shajareh Tayyebeh school attack in Minab, at both national and international levels, according to the Iranian state news agency IRNA.

heading: Relations between Iran and Russia expanding across several sectors: Pezeshkian
body: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says relations between Tehran and Moscow are expanding, according to a report by the Iranian news agency IRNA.

heading: Navi Pillay, who called out Israel’s genocide in Gaza, wins Nobel Peace Prize
body: South African jurist Navi Pillay, who fought apartheid and called out Israel’s genocide in Gaza, has won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize.

heading: Trump reiterates claim Tehran ‘weeks away’ from having nuclear weapon
body: Trump has doubled down on remarks that Washington stopped Iran from deploying a nuclear weapon.

heading: US senator calls Iran war a ‘national humiliation’ and a ‘debacle’
body: US Democrat Senator Chris Murphy has called the US’s war against Iran a “national humiliation”.

heading: Yemeni government says Houthi airport attacks ‘terrorise the innocent’
body: The foreign affairs ministry of Yemen’s internationally recognised government has expressed its “full solidarity” with Saudi Arabia, following the Houthi attacks on King Khalid International Airport that killed three citizens.
